name: Network Threat Explorer
tagline: A small app plus a local security toolkit to explore threats in a legacy network-traffic dataset.
problem: The team wanted to learn network forensics with no prior experience.
solution: A Flask and DuckDB app for querying the traffic dataset, alongside a local open-source network-analysis suite for visual exploration.
demo_moment: Team-described: query suspicious flows and inspect them in the dashboards.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “CSE: Network Traffic Exploration” among 261 submissions.
A beginner team learned the field during the event.

lessons: Sponsor challenges with fixed datasets reward getting hands on the data early.
